confirm.delete_selection: Move the selected items to Trash?
upload.resume_mismatch: The file you picked doesn't match the paused upload's name and size. Please pick the same file.
upload.from_url_prompt: Enter the URL of the file to upload:
upload.resume_pending: Unfinished upload for ":name" — pick the same file again to resume where it left off.
sort.name: Sort by name
playlist.empty: You haven't created a playlist yet. Collect your favorite video and audio clips into ordered playlists.
playlist.confirm_delete: This will permanently delete the playlist ":name". Continue?
playlist.item_empty: This playlist is empty. Add video or audio clips to it from the file manager.
share.confirm_revoke: This will permanently revoke this share link. Continue?
trash.confirm_force_delete: This will permanently delete this item and cannot be undone. Continue?
trash.confirm_empty: This will permanently empty the entire Trash. Continue?
trash.retention_notice: Items are automatically deleted forever :days days after being moved to Trash.
rename.title: Rename ":name"
move.title: Move ":name" to

share.email_label: Send by email (separate addresses with a comma)

preferences.description: Choose the display language for the user interface.
profile.info_description: Update your name and email address.
profile.resend_verification: Click here to re-send the verification email.
profile.verification_resent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
password.title: Update password
password.description: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
account.delete_description: Once your account is deleted, all of its files and data will be permanently deleted. Please download any data you wish to keep before deleting your account.
account.delete_confirm_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
account.delete_confirm_description: Once your account is deleted, all of its files and data will be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.
admin.users.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete the user ":name"? All of their files will be permanently deleted.
admin.users.quota: Storage quota (MB, leave blank for default)
permissions.title: Role permission matrix
permissions.description: The Admin role always has every permission and doesn't appear in this table. The table below controls what every other role can do within their own space, and also what unauthenticated guests can do when "Guest access" is enabled.
mail.title: Email settings (SMTP)
mail.password_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current value
mail.notifications_title: Event notifications (sent to every active admin)
security.guest_access: Allow unauthenticated guests to browse public folders (per the "Guest" role's permissions)
security.remote_upload: Allow uploading files from an external URL (Remote Upload)
security.captcha_reset: Show on the password reset page
security.captcha_download: Show when a guest downloads a file from a public share link
security.recaptcha_enabled: Use Google reCAPTCHA instead of the simple math captcha
settings.title: General settings
settings.custom_css: Custom CSS (optional, applied on top of the current design)
settings.max_zip_files: Maximum number of files in a single ZIP archive
settings.extension_note: This list is in addition to the fixed security list (php, phtml, exe...) which cannot be disabled from here.
settings.thumbnails_description: Show real thumbnails for images directly, for videos (requires ffmpeg on the server), and for the first page of PDF files (requires the Imagick extension). When the required tool isn't available, the generic icon is shown automatically instead with no error.
settings.video_quality_description: When enabled, the server automatically creates lower-resolution copies of every uploaded video (requires ffmpeg on the server), giving the viewer a quality picker just like YouTube. When the tool isn't available, the original video keeps playing with no effect.
settings.video_transcoding_enable: Automatically create different quality copies when a video is uploaded
settings.interactive_video_description: When enabled, anyone with the "Manage questions" permission can add questions that appear and pause the video at a specific moment, and each viewer's score is recorded. When disabled, the questions button disappears entirely and videos play uninterrupted, without deleting any previously saved questions or scores.
settings.content_indexing_description: When enabled, text is extracted from Word, PDF, PowerPoint, and text files on upload, making search able to find a file from its internal content and not just its name — just like a library or publisher's index.
settings.content_indexing_enable: Automatically extract and index text on upload (Word, PDF, PowerPoint, text)
settings.global_search: Enable global search across all folders (not just the current folder)
preview.no_preview: No preview is available for this file type. Please download it to view it.
preview.no_extracted_text: No extracted text for this file.
preview.report_no_answers: No one has answered the questions yet.
guest.browse_without_login: Browse public files without signing in
settings.extension_add: Type an extension and press Enter
admin.users.folders_hint: These folders appear in their files, and they work inside them with their role (an editor uploads, edits and adds).
share.public_limit_reached: This file has reached its maximum number of downloads.
share.public_download_disabled: Downloading is disabled for this share.
twofactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twofactor.description: An extra layer of protection for your account: after entering your password, you'll also be asked for a verification code from an authenticator app on your phone (such as Google Authenticator or Authy).
twofactor.scan_instructions: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually, then type the 6-digit verification code to enable protection.
twofactor.recovery_codes_notice: Store these recovery codes somewhere safe — each code can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app, and they won't be shown again after you leave this page.
twofactor.disable_description: Enter your current password to confirm disabling two-factor authentication on your account.
preview.document_failed: This document could not be shown here. Download it to open it.
guest.browse_site: Browse the site without signing in
admin.users.examiner_hint: Writes exams, marks them and sees the results
admin.users.time_multiplier_hint: For accommodations: 1.5 = half as much time again
exam.case_sensitive: Exact match (do not ignore case, hamza or diacritics)
exam.delete_warn: Its questions and every attempt and mark are deleted for good.
exam.description_ph: A text or passage the next questions refer to
exam.essay_hint: Marked by hand on the results page.
exam.facility_hint: Facility = the average share of the points students earned. Under 30% may mean a very hard question or a wrong key.
exam.fix_errors: Not saved: fix the marked errors.
exam.has_attempts: This exam has :n attempts. Editing questions changes no marks until you press «Regrade» on the results page; deleting a question deletes its answers.
exam.languages: Exam languages (the first is the default)
exam.manage_empty: No exams yet. Press «New exam» to start.
exam.multiple_hint: Tick every correct one. Partial credit: each wrong pick cancels a right one.
exam.no_changes_after: Answers cannot be changed after submitting.
exam.none_available: No exams are published right now.
exam.ordering_hint: Write the items in their right order; students see them shuffled.
exam.pending_note: Some essay answers are not marked yet; the mark may change.
exam.question: Question
exam.show_answers: Show the correct answers in the review
exam.show_results: Show the mark to the student
exam.subject: Subject
exam.submitted_hidden: Your answers were submitted. The result will be announced later.
exam.timer_note: The timer starts when you press; the exam is submitted by itself when time runs out.
exam.title: Title
exam.cloze_hint_typed: A blank the student types: [[Baghdad|baghdad]] — any of the written answers is accepted.
exam.cloze_hint_select: A list to pick from: [[*Basra|Mosul|Erbil]] — the star marks the right one; options are shown shuffled.
exam.cloze_hint_langs: Every language has the same blanks in the same order. Partial credit by the number of right blanks.
exam.import_hint: An Excel or CSV file with the columns Type, Question, Choice 1…, Answer, Points — or a Word file (.docx) or text in Aiken or GIFT form, or Moodle XML (.xml). Questions are added at the end. Save your changes first.
exam.students_hint: An Excel or CSV file with Name, Email or Student number (or both) and Password (optional; generated when empty). A file with every account and its password downloads next — keep it, it is not shown again.
exam.file_too_big: The file is larger than allowed.
exam.upload_failed: The file could not be uploaded.
exam.classify_hint: Put each item in its category.
exam.hotspot_hint: Click the right place on the picture.
exam.random_hint: Each student gets different questions from the category; the points above are for each one.
exam.bank_create_first: Create a category in the question bank first
exam.classify_edit_hint: Write each item's category, using the same name for items that belong together. At least two categories; partial credit.
exam.upload_hint: The student uploads one file, marked by hand on the results page.
exam.hotspot_edit_hint: Drag on the picture to mark a right area (or click for a small square). A student's click inside any area is right.
exam.bank_no_questions: No questions in this category yet.
exam.bank_empty: No categories yet. Create one (e.g. “Chemistry — term 1”) and add questions to it.
exam.delete_category: Delete the category and its questions
exam.bank_hint: To add questions from an exam: “To the bank” under each question in the exam editor. To use them: “From the bank” or a random slot in the editor.
exam.share_category: Shared: every teacher can use it (only its owner edits it)
exam.alpha_hint: Cronbach's alpha: how consistently the exam's questions measure the same thing. 0.7 or more is acceptable.
exam.stats_hint: Worked out from each student's first submitted attempt. Random questions from the bank are left out of the question analysis, since not every student had them.
exam.discrimination_hint: Discrimination = whether stronger students get it right more often: above 0.3 good, below 0.2 weak, and a negative value calls for checking the key.
exam.print_random: :n random questions from “:c” (drawn for each student in the online exam).
exam.practice_hint: A «Check» button on each question shows the answer at once; the answer is then fixed.
exam.seb_hint: A locked browser for exams in the hall: no other tabs or apps.
exam.seb_keys: SEB keys (Config Key or Browser Exam Key, one per line; empty = any SEB will do)
exam.seb_needed: This exam is taken in Safe Exam Browser only. Open it from the hall's computers, or in SEB with the settings your teacher gives you.
exam.practice_note: Practice exam: check each answer as soon as you write it.
exam.calc_hint: Write the variables in the question in braces, such as {v}. Each student gets different values from the range; the answer is the formula on them.
exam.calc_formula: Formula (e.g. v * t or sqrt(a^2 + b^2))
exam.double_marking: Double marking of essays and files
exam.double_marking_hint: Two independent markers; close marks are averaged. Add the markers on the results page.
exam.marking_tolerance: Largest accepted gap between the two markers (% of the question's points)
exam.mark_disputed: Markers disagree — the exam's owner decides
exam.markers_hint: A marker sees the results page and marks; they cannot edit the exam, and they do not see a colleague's mark before giving their own. You are a marker too.
exam.groups_empty: No groups yet. Make one for each class or section, e.g. “Year 2 — section A”.
exam.emails_ph: An e-mail or student number per line
exam.import_into_group: New accounts from Excel into this group
exam.import_into_group_hint: Columns: name, e-mail or student number, password (optional). Existing accounts are only added. A file of the new passwords is downloaded.
exam.group_no_members: No students in this group yet.
exam.groups_hint: To give an exam to a group, pick it in the exam's settings. An exam with no group is seen by every student.
exam.delete_group_q: Delete the group “:n”? The students and their accounts stay.
exam.given_to_groups: Only the chosen groups' students see it.
exam.given_to_all: No group chosen: every student sees it.
exam.access_code: Hall access code (the invigilator announces it at the start)
exam.allowed_ips: Hall computers only (addresses or ranges, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24)
admin.users.invigilator_hint: Watches running exams and takes attendance, without changing questions or marks
exam.monitor_empty: No exams running or coming up now.
exam.announce_ph: A message to every student in this exam (e.g. 10 minutes left)
exam.monitor_no_students: No students here. An exam with no group lists those who started it or were marked present.
exam.reopen_q: Reopen :n's attempt? Its mark is cleared until they submit again.
exam.submit_q: Submit :n's attempt now with the saved answers?
exam.submit_all_q: Submit every running attempt now? (end of the session)
exam.cards_q: Each student in the group gets a new password printed on their card, and their current passwords stop working. The cards are shown only once. Go on?
exam.cards_once: The passwords will not be shown again: print them now.
exam.kept_on_device: Offline — :n kept on this device, sent automatically
exam.emergency_hint: If the connection does not come back: download this file and give it to the invigilator
exam.offline_file_ok: :n answers put in for :s, and submitted.
exam.offline_file_upload: Upload a student's emergency answers file
exam.ip_hint: To find any computer's address without signing in, open /ip on it — e.g. https://exams.lan/ip — and its address and name show in large type. Fix the computers' addresses in the router (DHCP reservation) so they do not change.
exam.add_pcs_bulk: Several computers: “name address” on each line
exam.resume_code_hint: Whoever leaves the page or opens it again is locked out until you give them their code
exam.bind_computers: Keep each student at their computer
exam.bind_computers_hint: Their exam opens only from their computer's address
exam.locked_text: You left the exam page or opened it again. Ask the invigilator for the resume code. Your answers are saved, and the time keeps running.
exam.rich_hint: Formatting, tables, pictures, sound, video, equations
exam.math_hint: Equations in any text: write them between $…$, e.g. $x^2 + \frac{1}{2}$, or use “Formatted text” for the equation button, tables, pictures, sound and video.
exam.no_going_back: No going back to earlier questions
exam.scratch_hint: Scratch paper on this device only; not sent or marked.
exam.drag_text_hint: Write the right words in the text between [[ and ]], e.g. The capital of Iraq is [[Baghdad]]. The student drags them from a list that also holds the wrong words below.
exam.label: Label
exam.drag_image_hint: Choose “Set its place” for a label, then drag on the picture over its right place.
exam.audio_hint: The student records the answer with the microphone; you listen and mark it on the results page.
exam.drawing_hint: The student draws or writes by hand on a pad (mouse, pen or finger); you mark it on the results page.
exam.anonymous_hint: The marker sees a paper number instead of the student's name
exam.appeals_hint: The student asks for a question to be reviewed from their result page
exam.rubric_sum: Total :s of :p (must equal the question's points)
exam.similar_hint: Looks for essays sharing long phrases, and papers with the same wrong answers. A prompt to look, not proof of cheating.
exam.reply_ph: Reply to the student (change the mark under “Mark” if needed)
exam.appeal_ph: Explain why you ask for the mark to be reviewed
exam.gradebook_empty: No exam has been given to this group yet.
exam.import_exam_hint: An exam file from another server (.json) or a QTI 3.0 package (.zip)
exam.export_package_hint: To move the exam to a hall's server or another server on a USB stick
exam.export_qti_hint: For other systems (Moodle and others): choice, true/false, short, numeric and essay questions
exam.results_bundle_hint: This server's results in a file, to put into the central server
exam.results_import_hint: A results file from a hall's server, for this same exam
settings.ai_hint: Suggests a mark and a reason for written answers, by the rubric; the teacher decides. Needs an Anthropic API key, and sends the question and the answer without the student's name. Not on the offline server.
settings.ai_key_kept: Saved; leave empty to keep it
exam.variants_hint: Neighbouring computers get different versions (A, B, C) with a different order of questions and choices
exam.protect_hint: The student's name as a watermark on the page; no copying, selecting or right-click menu
exam.warn_1: One minute left. The exam is submitted automatically when time runs out.
exam.receipt_hint: Keep this code or take a photo of it: it proves your answers were submitted and recorded.
exam.extend_all: Hall stop: time for every student
exam.extend_all_q: How many minutes was the exam stopped? They are added to every running attempt.
auth.student_number_hint: The student signs in with it instead of an e-mail. No e-mail? Leave it empty and fill in the number.
exam.scan_ph: Scan a student's card here to mark them present
exam.arrange: Lay the room out on the map
exam.arrange_hint: The room's computers are placed by name in rows from the front of the hall; change any computer's seat by clicking it in the table. Exam versions alternate between neighbouring seats.
exam.card_qr: Scan to sign in and check in
exam.template_name: Name a new template from these settings
exam.template_applied: Applied «:n» — check the settings, then save.
exam.photos_hint: A ZIP with one picture per student named by student number or e-mail (2024001.jpg). Only the invigilator sees it, beside the student's name.
admin.users.photo_hint: The invigilator uses it to check the student's identity. The student cannot change it.
exam.reviewer: Question reviewer before publishing (another teacher's e-mail, optional)
exam.review_wait: Waiting for :n's review; it is not published before.
exam.health_load: The processor is under heavy load
exam.gradesheet_hint: Type the institution and committee names before printing.
exam.assignment_note: Assignment: your answers are saved as you go, and you can leave and come back until the deadline, then submit.
exam.prerequisite_note: Before this exam, finish the practice exam:
exam.assignment_hint: No timer: submitted before the closing date; the student can leave and come back. Leave the duration empty.
exam.prerequisite: Requires finishing another exam first (usually a practice one)
exam.clock_hint: This computer's clock is wrong; the timer uses the server's, but set it right.
exam.blueprint: Blueprint: draw the exam from the bank by chapter and difficulty
exam.blueprint_hint: Rows are the bank's question tags (chapters, objectives, Bloom levels…), columns the difficulty. Write how many questions to draw from each cell; every student gets different questions in the same spread.
exam.sessions: Several sittings of the same exam (optional)
exam.sessions_hint: Each student enters only in their sitting; the invigilator assigns them from the monitor. Random questions differ for each student.
exam.resources: Open book: PDF files the student opens inside the exam
exam.mixed_hint: Students of the groups (sections) in turn, so two classmates do not sit side by side
exam.kiosk_hint: A Windows file that opens the exam site full screen in Edge or Chrome without an address bar or tabs. Put it in the Startup folder (Win+R, then shell:startup) and the computer opens on the exam. To leave: Alt+F4.
exam.clashes_n: :n exams clash: the same hall or the same group at the same time.
exam.schedule_empty: No exams with times in this period. Set «Opens» or the sittings in the exam's settings.
exam.report_empty: No submitted exams for this student.
exam.by_tag_hint: Weakest first: what the student got of the points of the questions with each tag.
exam.no_session_yet: Your sitting is not set yet.
exam.checklist_item: Item (e.g. washes hands before the examination)
exam.osce_hint: Each assessor opens «Monitor → Assessing at stations» on their device and fills each candidate's checklist.
exam.osce_note_ph: A note for the candidate or the committee (optional)
exam.osce_pick: Pick the candidate in front of you.
exam.osce_note: Practical exam: you move between stations and an assessor marks you at each. Your mark shows here after assessment.
exam.osce_hint_short: Stations and checklists for a practical/clinical exam
exam.omr_hint_short: Paper answer sheets with bubbles, marked by scanning
exam.omr_skipped: :n questions that are not multiple choice or true/false are not on the sheet; mark them by hand.
exam.omr_how: Fill the circle completely with a black or dark blue pen. Do not write near the black squares or on the code.
exam.omr_err_corners: The four black squares were not found: scan the whole sheet, straight.
exam.omr_err_qr: The sheet's QR code could not be read.
exam.omr_scan_hint: Scan the sheets (or photograph them straight on a light surface with all four corners showing). They are read here in the browser. Doubtful questions show in yellow: click the right option, then save.
exam.adaptive_hint: Questions come from the bank one by one: it starts at medium, a right answer brings a harder question and a wrong one an easier one. Forward only; the questions written here are ignored.
exam.mirror_intro: A second computer on the network holds the same server and takes, every minute, what changed on the main server: accounts, exams, attempts and answers. If the main one fails, point the hall's computers at the standby and the students go on from the last minute. Uploaded files (photos, answer files) go with the regular backups.
exam.mirror_main_hint: Make a key, then type this address and the key on the standby server.
exam.mirror_enable: Turn on and make a key
exam.hall_sync_hint: Linked hall servers take it (unpublished) when they are online, and send its results back here.
exam.central_main_hint: Hall servers take from here the exams marked «Sent to the halls' servers» and send back their results whenever they are online, so students see their results and appeal from home. Type this address and the key on each hall server.
exam.central_hall_hint: Every ten minutes, when there is internet: it takes new exams from the central server (unpublished, for the teacher to check and publish here) and sends the results. Without internet it works as it is.
exam.central_last: Last good sync: :at — :a exams taken, results of :b sent
exam.messages_hint: The institution's message gateway (SMS or WhatsApp). Write its address with {phone} and {message} in place, and the request body for POST if it needs one. Results and reminders are sent from each exam's results page, to whoever has a phone number.
exam.messages_test_ph: A number for a test message
exam.notify_results_hint: An SMS/WhatsApp to each student with their mark
exam.notify_results_q: Send each student their mark by message?
exam.notify_reminder_q: Send all students a reminder of the exam?
exam.notify_done: :s messages sent, :f failed, :n without a phone number.
exam.ai_generate: Draft questions from a lecture with AI
exam.ai_generate_hint: Attach the lecture (PDF, Word or text) or paste it. The questions show here for you to review; only what you keep goes into the bank.
exam.ai_paste: Or paste the lecture's text here
exam.dash_bank_hint: :u of :n questions were used in real exams.
exam.amc_hint: Free software for printing and reading bubble sheets; export the results as CSV with «ticked boxes» as letters.
exam.amc_server: Auto Multiple Choice on the server
exam.amc_built: The sheets are ready to print: a named sheet for each student.
exam.amc_imported: Results of :n students entered; they show on the results page.
exam.amc_unknown: Sheets not matched to a student: :k
exam.amc_building: Building the sheets… (may take a minute)
exam.amc_build: Build the sheets from the exam
exam.amc_build_hint: Build again if you change the questions or the students, then print again.
exam.amc_scan_hint: Scan at 200–300 dpi, each file up to 32 MB.
exam.amc_connector_hint: AMC runs on a Linux server (the amc-connector container). On the hosted site it is set up already; for a hall server, type the local AMC server's address and its key.
exam.amc_env: Now: the one set in the server's environment.
exam.alert_other_pc: is sitting at someone else's computer
exam.alerts_denied: Device notifications are blocked in the browser settings
exam.alerts_hint: Sound and vibration on a help request, a lost connection, a lock or the wrong computer.
exam.install_hint: Install monitoring as an app on your phone: it opens with a tap and alerts you to help requests and lost connections.
exam.offsite_hint: Every night (2:40) a copy of the database goes to S3-compatible cloud storage (Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi...), encrypted here with your passphrase so the storage company cannot read it. Keep the passphrase somewhere safe: without it the copies cannot be opened.
exam.offsite_restore: To open a downloaded copy: php artisan backup:offsite --decrypt=FILE, then php artisan backup:restore.
exam.watch_hint: Every five minutes the server checks itself: disk, memory, database, background jobs, the AMC server and the off-site backup. When something goes wrong you get an alert (repeated every six hours while it lasts), and another when it is fixed.
exam.watch_ntfy: Phone notifications through the ntfy app (free): topic address
exam.watch_ntfy_hint: Install the ntfy app on your phone and subscribe to the same address (the part after ntfy.sh/). The random address is secret: don't publish it.
exam.watch_no_sms: set up the gateway below first
exam.watch_outside: To learn when the whole server stops (power or network), point a free outside monitor such as UptimeRobot at:
exam.a11y_offline: Connection lost; your answers are kept on this device
exam.keys_hint: Keyboard: numbers 1–9 choose an answer, the ← → arrows move between questions, and Tab moves between controls.
hallmap.title: Halls map
hallmap.search: Find a computer or a student…
hallmap.scan: Scan any computer's sticker to say where you are
hallmap.scan_title: Point the camera at the QR sticker on the nearest computer or wall
hallmap.scan_unknown: This code is not one of the halls map's stickers.
hallmap.no_webgl: This device or browser cannot show 3D (WebGL).
hallmap.pr.help: The student is asking for help
hallmap.pr.locked: The attempt is locked (left the page or opened it again)
hallmap.pr.wrong_pc: The student is not at the computer assigned to them
hallmap.pr.student_elsewhere: The student assigned here is sitting at another computer
hallmap.pr.disconnected: Nothing from this computer for over a minute and a half (network, cable or the computer)
hallmap.pr.time_up: Time is up and the attempt was not submitted
hallmap.pr.off_expected: The computer is off or offline and a student is assigned to it
hallmap.unlinked: This computer on the map is not linked to a registered computer. Link it in «Draw the halls».
hallmap.no_route: No way found to this computer.
hallmap.no_lift_route: No way by lift to this computer.
hallmap.live_hint: Hold the phone in front of you and walk: the arrow moves with your steps. For accuracy scan the QR sticker on any computer you pass.
hallmap.unplaced: :n computers not placed on the map
hallmap.empty: The halls map has not been drawn yet
hallmap.empty_text: Draw the halls and put the computers in place: they show here in 3D with each computer's state live, and the way to it.
hallmap.computer_hint: Computers are registered with their addresses on the «Hall computers» page. Linked ones show their state live on the map.
hallmap.bulk_link: Link to a room's computers in order (row by row)
hallmap.bulk_link_hint: The first takes PC-01 and so on, and each takes its name.
hallmap.generate_text: Choose a layout; the computers are linked to the hall's registered computers in order (PC-01 first). Afterwards you can drag any computer to its place.
hallmap.gen_link: Link them to the room's computers:
hallmap.gen_replace: Replace the current computers (tables and walls stay)
hallmap.chk_unlinked: :item is not linked to a registered computer: its state will not show.
hallmap.unplaced_edit: :n registered computers are not on the map.
hallmap.unplaced_none: Every registered computer is on the map.
hallmap.unplaced_hint: Place them with «Computer» or «Automatic rows», or link them from the computer's panel.
hallmap.copy_hint: Put every computer in its place and link it to the registered computer: its state then shows live (on, working, help, lost connection, wrong clock).
hallmap.qr_count_all: :n stickers. A computer's sticker goes on the side of its screen, a wall sticker where it says.
hallmap.qr_none: No computers on the map yet.
hallmap.qr_hint: For invigilators: scan to see where you are and the way to any computer
admin.cards.title: Login cards
admin.cards.intro: Choose students and each gets a card on A4 paper (ten a page, cut along the dashed lines): the name, the user name, a new password, the system's address and its IP address, the Wi-Fi name, and a QR code that signs the student straight in.
admin.cards.label: Label on the card (e.g. the class; empty = the student's group)
admin.cards.note: Note at the bottom of the card
admin.cards.qr_only_hint: The card carries the user name and the quick sign-in code only.
admin.cards.search: Search by name, student number or e-mail
admin.cards.name: Name
admin.cards.files_hint: They hold the passwords as they are: delete a file after printing unless the offline server needs it.
admin.cards.apply_title: A card file from the hosting (for the offline server)
admin.cards.apply_hint: Download the card file on the hosting and upload it here on the hall server: the same passwords and QR codes are saved for the students found here (by student number or e-mail), so the printed cards work on both.
admin.cards.confirm_new: :n users' passwords will change and their old cards will stop working. Sure?
admin.cards.confirm_qr: New QR cards for :n users (passwords stay; old cards stop working). Sure?
admin.cards.failed: The cards could not be made.
admin.cards.delete_confirm: Delete the card file «:name»? (the passwords in it do not change)
admin.cards.apply_confirm: Save the passwords and QR codes from this file on this server?
admin.cards.bar: :n cards · :p A4 pages · print, then cut along the dashed lines
admin.users.bulk_off_confirm: Suspend :n accounts? They cannot sign in until you activate them again. (Your account and the master admin's are never suspended)
admin.users.import_hint: An Excel or CSV file whose first row is headings: «Name» and «E-mail» or «Student number», optionally «Phone» and «Password». A file of the new passwords downloads afterwards. A file exported from this page imports too.
activity.search: Search the details, name or IP
activity.subject: Item
admin.users.confirm_disable: Suspend ":name"'s account? They cannot sign in until you activate it again.
admin.users.fill: Fill in the details, then save
admin.users.status_active_hint: Can sign in and use the system.
admin.users.status_inactive_hint: Cannot sign in; their files are kept.
analytics.p.shift: Since the start of the work day
hallmap.bg_hint: Draw the halls and corridors over the picture. «Calibrate»: tap both ends of a wall whose length you know, then type its length in metres, and the picture takes its true scale. The picture is only for you; invigilators don't see it.
hallmap.check_ok: The map is fine: every computer can be reached from the entrance.
hallmap.checking: Checking the way to every computer…
hallmap.chk_no_shelves: No computers on the map yet.
hallmap.chk_unreachable: No way from the entrance to :item (blocked by a computer or a wall, or a door or stairs is missing).
hallmap.chk_unreachable_n: No way from the entrance to :n computers:where (:codes). A door or stairs is missing, or a computer or wall blocks the way.
hallmap.edit3d_hint: Drag any computer to move it within its room (Alt to move it to another room) · drag the floor to turn the view · right-click any item for its options
hallmap.hall_hint: Moving or turning a hall moves what is inside it and its doors too. Select the hall, then add a computer to place it inside, facing the same way.
hallmap.hall_name: Hall name (shown to invigilators in the directions)
hallmap.keys_hint: Drag to move · arrows for fine moves · R to rotate · Delete to remove. The dashed line is the computer's front, where the student sits.
hallmap.multi_hint: Tap computers to select them, or drag a box round them. (On a computer: Shift + click always works)
hallmap.multi_keys: Drag any selected computer to move them all · arrows for fine moves · Delete to remove.
hallmap.place_entrance: Tap the plan where the building's entrance is.
hallmap.qr_added: Added :n stickers on the walls (beside doors and stairs and along corridors). Every computer has its own sticker already. Save, then print them from «QR stickers».
hallmap.rows_here: Rows of computers in the hall
hallmap.separate_halls_hint: The invigilator sees only the hall they are in, and the map changes when they enter another hall.
hallmap.wiz_keep: Keep the current computers (only halls, corridors and doors are replaced)
hallmap.wizard_text: Choose the building's shape and the whole plan is built; then drag and change any hall or door.
languages.active_hint: When off it disappears from the language choice and its users go back to the default language
languages.code_hint: Two or three Latin letters (ISO), e.g. tr or ckb
languages.confirm_delete: Delete this language and all its translations? Its users go back to the default language.
languages.name: Language name
languages.new_hint: The language's name as users see it
library.map.bg_failed: The file could not be uploaded.
library.map.bg_from_plan: Draw over a picture of the plan
library.map.bg_intro: A picture of the building's plan (from a phone, or a PDF from the engineer) under the drawing, one per floor. You draw the halls over it quickly and to the right scale.
library.map.bg_move_hint: Drag the picture into place, then press «Done».
library.map.bg_upload: Upload a picture or PDF of the plan
library.map.bulk_codes: Number them in order (row by row)
library.map.calib_1: Tap one end of a wall (or door) whose length you know in the picture, then its other end.
library.map.calib_ask: How long is this distance really (in metres)?
library.map.camera_error: The camera could not be opened. Allow the site to use it, or scan the sticker with the phone's camera directly.
library.map.check_count: :e problems and :w warnings. Tap any line to go to it.
library.map.check_unsaved: The check includes your unsaved changes.
library.map.chk_no_qr: No QR stickers on the walls. «Automatic QR» adds them beside doors and stairs.
library.map.chk_no_stairs: :storey is not linked by stairs to the floor below (put stairs in the same place on both floors).
library.map.compass_doubtful: The compass is unsure: hold the phone in front of you, or move it in a figure 8
library.map.compass_learning: Walk a few straight steps so it learns your direction
library.map.door_far: Tap on (or near) a wall of a hall or corridor.
library.map.door_hint: Tap any wall to put a door on it, and repeat for each door. Drag a door to move it along the wall.
library.map.draw_hint: Tap the plan at each corner of the obstacle in order, then tap the first point or «Finish the shape». (Back removes the last point)
library.map.empty_plan_wizard: Start with the «Building wizard»: choose a room or a building and the number of floors, and the halls, corridors and doors are built for you.
library.map.generate_in_hall: Built inside «:hall», facing the same way.
library.map.is_lift: This is a lift (fit for wheelchairs)
library.map.l_hint: Drag from a corner of the room to the opposite corner. Then «Change the cut corner» flips the L, and drag the inner corner to change the arms' width.
library.map.label: Short name
library.map.lock_all_hint: Stops anything being moved or resized by mistake. Selecting and editing details still works.
library.map.locked_all_note: Moving is locked. Unlock it from the toolbar to edit.
library.map.locked_note: :code is locked. Unlock it from its panel to move it.
library.map.name: Description (optional)
library.map.nearest_sticker_hint: About :d m · the place glowing orange on the map, and the circle on the floor where you stand.
library.map.no_sensors: The motion sensor was not allowed. Try «Preview the way», or allow the site in the browser settings.
library.map.no_stickers_here: No stickers in this part of the map.
library.map.qr_far: Tap inside the hall, close to the wall.
library.map.qr_hint_tool: Tap inside the hall near the wall the sticker goes on, and repeat for each sticker. The sticker faces the side you tapped.
library.map.qr_item_hint: Printed from «QR stickers» and stuck on this wall at eye level. Whoever scans it sees the map from this spot. Drag it to move it along the wall.
library.map.qr_none_added: Every suitable place has a sticker. You can add one by hand by tapping any wall.
library.map.rect_hint: Drag on the plan from one corner to the opposite one. Corners stick to the walls of neighbouring halls.
library.map.remove_storey_confirm: Everything on this floor will be removed from the plan. Continue?
library.map.rename_long: The name is longer than 30 characters.
library.map.rename_taken: Another item already has this name.
library.map.shape_hint: Drag the orange corners to change the shape · the faint dot in the middle of a side adds a corner · double-tap a corner to remove it.
library.map.spin_off: The map stays still (tap to turn it with you)
library.map.spin_on: The map turns with you (tap to keep it still)
library.map.stairs_all: Put it in the same place on every floor
library.map.stairs_hint: Stairs or a lift in the same place on two floors link them, and the way goes up or down by it.
library.map.where_stickers: Can't find a sticker? Show me the nearest
library.map.wiz_building_text: Halls along a corridor, one floor or more
library.map.wiz_summary: On each floor: :h halls, a corridor and stairs · area :w × :d m
library.map.wrong_way: You seem to be walking the wrong way. Turn round and follow the arrow.
notifications.title: Notifications
profile.avatar_crop_hint: Drag the photo to move it, and use the slider to zoom.
profile.avatar_failed: The photo could not be uploaded.
profile.avatar_not_image: Choose a picture file (JPG, PNG or WEBP).
profile.avatar_too_big: The picture is too big; the limit is 15 MB.
security.captcha_desc: Stops automated programs from creating accounts or downloading files in bulk.
security.ip_desc: Control which devices and networks can open the system.
security.oauth_desc: The provider's button shows on the sign-in page once both keys are entered.
security.recaptcha_desc: Instead of the simple sum question. Needs keys from Google.
settings.work_day_start: Start of the work day (for the activity log)
translations.leave_unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
exam.mic_denied: No access to the microphone. Allow the browser to use it, or ask for help.
exam.rt_eq_prompt: The equation in LaTeX, e.g. \\frac{a}{b} or x^2 + \\sqrt{y}
auth.2fa_code_hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.2fa_recovery_hint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification.
exam.health_cpu: The processor is under heavy load

hallmap.layout_walls_center: Walls + two facing rows in the middle
hallmap.layout_facing_hint: Every two rows back to back: the screens in the middle and the students facing each other. Room is left for the chairs on both sides.
hallmap.layout_walls_hint: Wall computers have their screen to the wall and the student facing it. No computer is put in front of a door, and aisles as wide as «Aisle» are left between the chairs.
hallmap.layout_select_hall: For accuracy: select the hall first, then open this window; otherwise the edges of the whole plan count as the walls.
hallmap.gen_group_pairs: Make each pair a group (moves together)
hallmap.gen_group_center: Make the middle computers a group (moves together)
hallmap.gen_group_hint: The middle computers are grouped: tap any of them to move them all.
hallmap.is_group: A group: moves together. Alt + click picks one of them alone.
hallmap.flip: Turn them round (screen to the other side)
hallmap.multi_keys2: Drag any selected computer to move them all · arrows for fine moves · Ctrl+G group · Ctrl+D copy · Delete to remove.
hallmap.multi_keys3: Drag any selected computer to move them all, and the blue circle above to turn them · arrows for fine moves · R turns 15° · Ctrl+G group · Ctrl+D copy · Delete to remove.
hallmap.gen_skipped: :m were left out because they do not fit inside the hall with their chairs.
exam.picture_only: Choose a picture (JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF).
exam.import_pictures_hint: With pictures: write each picture's file name in the «الصورة» or «صورة الخيار 1…» column, and upload the Excel file and the pictures together in one ZIP file.
exam.export_questions: Export the questions (Excel with pictures, ZIP)
hallmap.pr.suspect: Suspected cheating: the browser reported something suspicious in the last 10 minutes
hallmap.from_desk: the red way from the invigilator's desk
hallmap.more_suspects: and :n more in the problems list
exam.osce_start_hint: Press the time button when the candidate comes in, so their time at this station is counted on their route.
exam.groups_hint2: Each student is in one group: a student you add here is not offered when adding students to other groups. To give an exam to a group, choose it in the exam's settings; an exam with no groups is seen by every student.
exam.all_have_groups: Every registered student is in a group. Turn on «Students of other groups» to move some, or add new accounts.
exam.will_move: :n of them will move from their group to this one.
exam.emails_hint: Paste one student's e-mail or number per line. A student in another group is added only if you choose to move them.
exam.move_from_others: Move students who are in another group to this one
exam.choose_sheet: Choose an Excel or CSV file
exam.remove_one_q: Remove «:n» from the group? Their account stays, and they are offered again when adding students to any group.
exam.remove_many_q: Remove :n students from the group? Their accounts stay.
exam.students_group_hint: Add a «المجموعة» (group) column — and optionally «المرحلة» (stage) and «القسم» (department) — so each student goes straight into their group; a missing group is created, and students who already have an account move into it.
exam.leave_unsaved: There are unsaved changes (kept for now on this device). Leave anyway?
exam.draft_found: You have changes not saved, from :t on this device.
exam.draft_kept_hint: The changes are kept for now on this device until you press «Save».
